note: The springs everything moves on, which tokens.json's format can't hold. None overshoots: position and size at a damping ratio of 0.9, colour and fades at 1. Each platform converts them to its own spring parameters, keeping the damping ratio and stiffness.

springs.name: spatial-fast
springs.usage: Small things moving or resizing: a switch thumb, a segment. About 0.17s.

springs.name: spatial-default
springs.usage: Position and size by default: sheets, menus, pages, a card growing into its page.

springs.name: effects-fast
springs.usage: Quick colour and opacity changes: the press wash fading. About 0.10s.

springs.name: effects-default
springs.usage: Colour and fades by default, content replacing a skeleton.
